_doc: Post-deploy smoke for scripts/cmux-next/release/worker-release.ts verify (backend.yml deploy jobs). Routes without sources run after every deploy; the others when a matching file under backend/apps/api changed.

routes.name: stack webhook refuses an unsigned delivery
routes.why: 503 until STACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set, then 401 for no signature; never 500

routes.name: model router refuses an unsigned call
routes.why: 503 where INFERENCE_ENABLED is off, else 401 without a token; never 500

routes.name: hand-off store is bound (unsigned list refused)
routes.why: 401 = HANDOFF_DO and HANDOFF_INDEX_DO are bound and the route asks for a sign-in; 404 means they are not. Production stays 404 until its v18 do_tags approval (scripts/cmux-next/release/production-approvals.json)

routes.name: chief brain route is on (unsigned read refused)
routes.why: 401 = CHIEF_BRAIN_ENABLED is 1 and the route asks for sign-in; 404 = brains are off. A promote (no change set) runs it, so production proves the brain is on; the chief-off switch deploys the serving commit again, so its smoke skips it

routes.name: hands flag (install script)
routes.why: 200 where HANDS_ENABLED is 1 (development, staging, previews); production keeps hands off (404) until the hands decision
